mapper.sql: select w.warn_id, w.warn_level, w.warn_type, w.source_module, w.target_object_id, w.target_type, w.enterprise_id, w.enterprise_name, w.region_code, w.content, w.evidence_url, w.warn_status, w.assign_to, w.assign_name, w.create_time, w.resolve_time, w.remark from t_warning w
mapper.select: order by w.create_time desc, w.warn_id desc

select count(1) as total_count, sum(case when w.warn_status = '0' then 1 else 0 end) as pending_count, sum(case when w.warn_status = '1' then 1 else 0 end) as processing_count, sum(case when w.warn_status = '2' then 1 else 0 end) as closed_count, sum(case when w.warn_status = '3' then 1 else 0 end) as misreport_count, sum(case when w.warn_status = '4' then 1 else 0 end) as upgraded_count, sum(case when w.warn_level = '1' then 1 else 0 end) as tip_count, sum(case when w.warn_level = '2' then 1 else 0 end) as yellow_count, sum(case when w.warn_level = '3' then 1 else 0 end) as red_count, sum(case when w.source_module = 'SOCIAL' then 1 else 0 end) as social_count, sum(case when w.source_module = 'TAX' then 1 else 0 end) as tax_count, sum(case when w.source_module = 'EXPANSION' then 1 else 0 end) as expansion_count, sum(case when w.source_module = 'SPECIAL' then 1 else 0 end) as special_count, sum(case when w.source_module = 'DEVICE' then 1 else 0 end) as device_count, sum(case when w.source_module = 'INJURY' then 1 else 0 end) as injury_count from t_warning w

select w.warn_level as dimension_key, case when w.warn_level = '1' then '提示' when w.warn_level = '2' then '黄警' when w.warn_level = '3' then '红警' else '其他' end as dimension_label, count(1) as dimension_count from t_warning w
group by w.warn_level order by w.warn_level asc

select w.source_module as dimension_key, case when w.source_module = 'SOCIAL' then '社保联动' when w.source_module = 'TAX' then '个税联动' when w.source_module = 'EXPANSION' then '扩面联动' when w.source_module = 'SPECIAL' then '专项治理' when w.source_module = 'DEVICE' then '设备联动' when w.source_module = 'INJURY' then '工伤事件' else ifnull(w.source_module, '其他') end as dimension_label, count(1) as dimension_count from t_warning w
group by w.source_module order by dimension_count desc, w.source_module asc

select ifnull(w.region_code, '') as dimension_key, ifnull(w.region_code, '未配置区域') as dimension_label, count(1) as dimension_count from t_warning w
group by w.region_code order by dimension_count desc, w.region_code asc limit 5

select w.warn_status as dimension_key, case when w.warn_status = '0' then '待处理' when w.warn_status = '1' then '处理中' when w.warn_status = '2' then '已办结' when w.warn_status = '3' then '误报' when w.warn_status = '4' then '已升级' else '其他' end as dimension_label, count(1) as dimension_count from t_warning w
group by w.warn_status order by w.warn_status asc

select count(1) from t_warning w
and w.warn_status in ('0', '1') and timestampdiff(hour, w.create_time, sysdate()) > 48

select count(1) from t_warning w
and w.warn_status = '2' and w.resolve_time is not null and timestampdiff(hour, w.create_time, w.resolve_time) <= 72
mapper.update: update t_warning set warn_status = #{warnStatus}, assign_name = #{assignName}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = sysdate(), resolve_time = case when #{resolveFlag} then sysdate() else resolve_time end where warn_id = #{warnId}
